newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish BOS bank bourse entry likely late January.
newsitem.headline: Polish BOS bank bourse entry likely late January.

text.p: Polish Bank Ochrony Srodowiska SA (BOS), which is seeking a main market listing, is likely to debut on the Warsaw bourse in late January, a bank official said on Friday.
The bank's capital investments director, Krzysztof Wielgus, said the bank expected the supervisory board of the Warsaw bourse to decide on approving its shares for bourse trade in mid-January.
"If everything goes as planned the bourse debut will take place in the end of January," he told Reuters.
BOS' November initial public offering of 1.2 million shares, priced at 29 zlotys per share, was largely oversubscribed.
The bank, which specialises in funding environmental protection projects, netted 31.8 million zlotys in 1995 and had 210.6 million zlotys in interest and other related revenues.
